*[[Moore County substation attack]]
**Over 40,000 customers are [[power outage|without power]] after two [[power substation]]s in [[Moore County, North Carolina]], United States, are deliberately damaged by gunfire on Saturday night. A curfew has been ordered, and power restoration is expected to take until Thursday. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/12/04/us/power-outage-moore-county-criminal-investigation/index.html (CNN)]
